problem.complexity: Expected O(n) time with dictionary lookups and O(n) extra space. The input list is unchanged.
constraints: Every nums element is an integer between -1000000000 and 1000000000 inclusive.
target is an integer between -2000000000 and 2000000000 inclusive.
A valid pair is not guaranteed.

examples.explanation: Use two distinct positions; their values sum to target.

problem.explanation: Scan increasing j. Before storing nums[j], look up its complement among earlier values. Keeping the first index for each value gives the smallest i for that j. Checking before insertion prevents reusing an index. If no match appears, return []. For [1, 1, 2] and target 3, keep index 0 for value 1 and return [0, 2].
hints: Scan from left to right. For each value, what complement would reach target?
Keep the earliest index for each value. Check the complement before storing the current index.
Return the first matching pair you encounter; return [] if the scan finishes without a match.

publication_contract.behavior: Find distinct indices i < j with nums[i] + nums[j] == target. Return [i, j]. If several pairs work, choose the smallest j, then the smallest i. Do not modify nums.

publication_contract.exception_behavior: Inputs satisfy the declared constraints; no exception is expected.
publication_contract.no_solution: Return an empty list []. Never reuse one index.
